scripts.build:local: npm run build:prompts && npm run build:web && npm run build:node
scripts.build: npm run build:prompts && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: cd web && node scripts/build-html.mjs && vite build --config vite.layout.config.ts && node scripts/build-vue-pages.mjs && node scripts/build-legacy-pages.mjs
scripts.backtest:institutional-top100:refresh: npm run generate:institutional-tracks && npm run backtest:institutional-top100
scripts.backtest:institutional-top100:triggered-: node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --stock-limit 100 --from 2021-07-31 --concurrency 18 --analysis-cohort triggered --first-loss-pcts 10,15,20,25,30 --second-loss-pcts 20,25,30,35,40 --sell-fractions 35,50,70 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top100-近5年实际触发减仓样本回测.md

node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --strategy cash-ladder --cash-baseline full-stock --stock-limit 100 --from 2021-07-31 --concurrency 6 --initial-cash-pcts 20,35,50 --first-loss-pcts 10,15,20 --second-loss-pcts 20,25,30,35,40 --cash-buy-splits 35/65,50/50,65/35 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top100-近5年预留现金分批买入对比全仓死扛回测.md

scripts.backtest:institutional-top300:industry:5: node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --stock-limit 300 --from 2021-07-31 --concurrency 18 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top300-近5年行业分层减仓加仓回测.md

scripts.test:local-runtime: npm run build:node && esbuild src/shared/request.test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/stock-info-local-runtime-request-test.mjs >/dev/null && node --test scripts/local-node-bindings.test.mjs scripts/lib/local-d1-sqlite.test.mjs scripts/check-no-wrangler-local.test.mjs /tmp/stock-info-local-runtime-request-test.mjs && npm run check:wrangler-local
scripts.test:research: research_test_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/stock-info-research-tests.XXXXXX) && esbuild src/modules/research/domain/*.test.mjs src/modules/research/application/research-statutory-operating-candidates.test.mjs src/modules/research/application/import-statutory-disclosure-to-knowledge.test.mjs src/modules/research/application/research-web-search-packages.test.mjs src/modules/research/application/research-operating-analysis.test.mjs src/adapters/eastmoney-finance-report-type.test.mjs src/adapters/yahoo-finance.test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir="$research_test_dir" >/dev/null && find "$research_test_dir" -name '*.test.js' -exec node --test {} + && node --test scripts/lib/operating-analysis-stage-plan.test.mjs
